fields.description: Issue includes local political and civic reporting centered on Miami municipal operations, including the city clerk’s admission that an audit will show an approximately $12,000 shortage attributed to court and bonding practices, and discussion of municipal court procedures and professional bondsmen. Coverage also addresses enforcement against marble board gambling devices and related city legal actions. Regular columns and features appear, including nightlife/entertainment items, advertisements, and a sports section with commentary and local sporting news.
